notes: Sweep on 2026-08-03 backfilled a genuine ~11-month coverage gap: CopyPasta License Attack (HiddenLayer, disclosed 2025-09-04) -- a self-replicating prompt-injection virus hidden in LICENSE.txt/README.md markdown comments, demonstrated against Cursor, Windsurf, Kiro, and Aider, no CVE/no vendor patch. Also found and folded in a second, distinct Cline CVE (CVE-2026-59723, Cline CLI Hub dashboard WebSocket, disclosed 2026-07-08/09, fixed 3.0.30) into the existing Cline CVE-2026-44211 advisory -- same missing-Origin-validation root cause recurring in a second Cline component. Extensive re-verification of the standard Tier-A/B/C rotation (npm/PyPI/Crates.io supply chain, MCP, Cursor/Claude Code/OpenClaw/aider/OpenHands/SWE-agent CVEs, Next.js/React/Svelte/Vite/Shadcn/Tailwind, Supabase/Prisma/NextAuth/FastAPI/Streamlit/Google AI Studio SDK, n8n/Zapier/Pipedream/Composio, industry-vendor blogs, social/Substack/HN) found everything else already tracked -- confirms this repo's daily-sweep cadence is keeping current; the two genuine finds both came from directly reading a primary research writeup (HiddenLayer) and a vendor's own GHSA page (GitHub) rather than the aggregator search rotation, reinforcing the standing 'read primary sources directly' practice.
